description: Use ONLY if the buyer already submitted a signed x402 payment but lost the HTTP receipt response. Provide a locally computed SHA-256 hex digest of the EXACT original Payment-Signature value, never the raw signature. Performs one free, read-only private-ledger lookup, returns the existing buyer-held recovery receipt ID when present and NEVER charges or creates another payment.

payment_signature_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact prior Payment-Signature header; private bearer fingerprint, not the signature or wallet key

name: kevaremesh_locate_owned_receipt
title: Recover an already reserved owned-API receipt without paying again
